name: CURV-III
def: US Navy remotely operated recovery vehicle, fourth in the CURV series, that made the deepest underwater rescue on record by saving two men trapped in a submersible in 1973.
facts: Rescued two men from Pisces III at 480 m after 76 hours trapped
Surveyed the SS Edmund Fitzgerald wreck in 1976
Replaced by the current generation, CURV-21
